svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-02
svg.desc: Data-driven projectile and pickup definitions, metadata migration, and Blueprint decoupling.
svg.text: 2026-08-02 - Data-driven projectiles, pickups, and metadata
main | 7 commits: 3deb301, 2c8085b, 3d8a423, a6293db, b668cac, 9171b93, a533eea
Daily job
Move pickup, projectile, and ability metadata away from Blueprint-only definitions.
JSON config, C++ loaders/controllers, asset cleanup, startup checkpoint, collision config, UI metadata, and migration docs changed.
BEFORE
Behavior hidden in assets
Pickup/projectile definitions were Blueprint-led.
Ability metadata had multiple sources.
Old assets could remain after migration.
UI and runtime could drift from config.
AFTER
Data selects; C++ executes; UI reads
ProjectileDefinitions.json and PickupDefinitions.json feed AuraGameplayConfig.
Ability metadata moves to runtime JSON and shared consumers.
Blueprint-only definitions are removed or emptied where no longer authoritative.
Collision channel, AbilityInfo UI metadata, startup checkpoint, and next-moves docs align.
Guard: deleted/empty Blueprint assets can be intentional migration results.
Important guard
Find the JSON source before restoring an old asset.
Keep loaders, runtime consumers, and UI metadata
on the same data contract.
Validation / newcomer path
Trace JSON -> AuraGameplayConfig -> C++ consumer.
Then inspect migration plans and the UI metadata.
The config path is the source-of-truth path.
